text: An octopus told me that his underwater cave is $245_{8}$ years old. How many years is this in base ten?
What is the degree of the polynomial $(3x^2 +11)^{12}$?
Our club has 20 members, 10 boys and 10 girls.  In how many ways can we choose a president and a vice-president if they must be of different gender?

How many 9 step paths are there from $E$ to $G$ which pass through $F$?[asy]size(4cm,4cm);int w=6;int h=5;int i;pen p=fontsize(9);for (i=0; i<h; ++i){draw((0,i) -- (w-1,i));}for (i=0; i<w; ++i){draw((i, 0)--(i,h-1));}label("G", (w-1,0), SE, p);label("E", (0,h-1), NW, p);label("F", (3,3), NE, p);[/asy]
If $5^x=100$, what is the value of $5^{x+2}$?
